title: The Business Partner Beside the Name
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: The person beside the name can carry finance, operations, relationships, governance, contradiction, and continuity—capacity that should be documented rather than erased as support.
One frame holds a named designer, a model, a photographer, a collection, and an institutional record—separate roles that public shorthand often compresses.
narrativeSequence.rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

narrativeSequence.caption: 01 · CAPACITY — What burden leaves the founder?. Name the decisions, relationships, records, calendars, risks, and emotional labor the partner carries. Replace “business side” with observable work and consequences.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · AUTHORITY — What may each person decide?. Write decision rights as verb plus object, threshold, required consultation, override, evidence, and appeal. Separate custom from enforceable authority.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · ECONOMICS — How are value and downside shared?. Map equity, votes, salary, royalty, bonus, expenses, guarantees, vesting, transfer, dilution, information, and exit separately. Public filings are examples, not templates.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · BREAK — What happens when alignment ends?. Run deadlock, incapacity, departure, nonperformance, acquisition, founder conflict, and reputational crisis through the actual governance and contract records with qualified counsel.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: Tapestry, Inc. Form 10-K for year ended June 27, 2026 is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
narrativeSequence.rights: Public filing; quote narrowly and transform facts into original diagrams.

mapping.prompt: List every recurring decision and who actually makes, advises, approves, records, and can reverse it.
Attach corporate, contract, account, and practice evidence separately.
Map economics and information access without assuming title equals value.
Review seven rupture scenarios with corporate, employment, tax, and IP counsel as relevant.
